shortdesc.ph: The state of last-mile network probe test.
The status of the last-mile probe test.

plentry.pd: (1): The last-mile network probe test is complete.
(2): The last-mile network probe test is incomplete due to limited testing resources, making bandwidth estimation unavailable. Possible reason: temporary resource constraints.
(3): The last-mile network probe test is not executed, possibly due to poor network conditions.
1: The last-mile network probe test is complete.

2: The last-mile network probe test is incomplete because the bandwidth estimation is not available due to limited test resources. One possible reason is that testing resources are temporarily limited.
3: The last-mile network probe test is not carried out. Probably due to poor network conditions.
